title: Slow-Roasted Paprika Pork Shoulder — Crispy Potatoes on Night 1, Székely-Style Sauerkraut on Night 2
description: One slow oven roast, two dinners: paprika and caraway pork shoulder braised on onions for 3 hours, served with crispy potatoes and apple slaw on night 1, then pulled and simmered with sauerkraut, sour cream and rye bread on night 2. Garlic-free.

steps.title: Rub the pork
steps.text: Heat the oven to 160°C fan. Pat the pork dry and trim the fat cap down to a thin layer (about 100 g comes off). Mix 1 tbsp sweet paprika, the smoked paprika, 2 tsp caraway, the marjoram, 2 tsp salt and the pepper with 15 ml oil, then rub it all over the pork.

steps.title: Build the braise
steps.text: Spread the sliced onions in a casserole or Dutch oven. Stir the tomato paste into the stock and pour it over the onions. Set the pork on top, fat side up.

steps.title: Braise covered, 3 h at 160°C
steps.text: Cover with the lid or tight foil and braise 3 hours, until a fork slides in with no resistance.

steps.title: Night 1: uncover and roast potatoes, 40 min at 200°C
steps.text: Take the lid off and turn the oven up to 200°C fan. Toss the potatoes with the remaining 15 ml oil, 1 tsp caraway and a pinch of salt and paprika, then spread them on a lined tray. Roast the potatoes and the uncovered pork together: pork comes out after 30 min, potatoes need 40 min in total.

steps.title: Night 1: make the slaw
steps.text: While everything roasts, whisk the 140 g yogurt, mustard, lemon juice and a pinch of salt. Toss with the red cabbage and apple.

steps.title: Rest and split
steps.text: Rest the pork 10 min, then pull it into large chunks: about 800 g of cooked meat. Tonight: Matthias 265 g, Nyuszika 135 g, plus half the onions and a spoonful of juices. Skim the fat off the remaining juices, then refrigerate the other 400 g pork, the rest of the onions and all the juices for night 2 (keeps 3 days).

steps.title: Night 1: plate
steps.text: Matthias: 265 g pork, 400 g potatoes (raw weight, about ¾ of the tray), about 70% of the slaw. Nyuszika: 135 g pork, 150 g potatoes, the rest of the slaw.

steps.title: Night 2: simmer the sauerkraut, 20 min
steps.text: Rinse the sauerkraut briefly in a sieve and squeeze it lightly. Put the reserved onions and juices in a wide pan with 1 tsp sweet paprika, ½ tsp caraway, the sauerkraut and 150 ml water. Cover and simmer gently 20 min, stirring once or twice.

steps.title: Night 2: add the pork, 8–10 min
steps.text: Shred the reserved 400 g pork, stir it in and heat uncovered 8–10 min, until piping hot and most of the liquid has reduced. Taste for salt.

steps.title: Night 2: plate
steps.text: Matthias: 265 g pork with about 250 g sauerkraut, topped with 50 g sour cream mixed with 50 g Greek yogurt, and 120 g rye bread. Nyuszika: 135 g pork with about 180 g sauerkraut, 40 g sour cream and 60 g rye bread.

notes: Macros shown are night 1's; the Greek yogurt in the slaw is Matthias's protein bridge. Night 2 (székely-style sauerkraut): Matthias ~1,135 kcal, 93 g protein, 81 g carbs, 45 g fat; Nyuszika ~590 kcal, 45 g protein, 44 g carbs, 24 g fat. Start around 15:30 for dinner around 19:30; night 2 takes about 30 min. Kifli swap: if lapocka is out, use pork neck (tarja) and trim it well — it's fattier.
